name: zerodha-portfolio-microservices
description: Zerodha & Coin Portfolio Intelligence - Microservices Architecture

scripts.start:services: concurrently "npm run start --prefix services/parser-service" "npm run start --prefix services/analytics-service" "npm run start --prefix services/recommendation-service" "node gateway/index.js"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix services/parser-service && npm install --prefix services/analytics-service && npm install --prefix services/recommendation-service && npm install --prefix gateway
